title: smith.toml
description: The configuration of a smith workspace (schema 1). Every setting has a default; a key smith does not know is an error.

schema.description: The smith.toml schema version; smith upgrade migrates older files.

scope.description: npm scope for Node packages, e.g. @acme.

module_prefix.description: Go module path prefix, e.g. github.com/acme/repo.

exclude.description: Workspace-relative globs (examples/**) of directories whose manifests are not projects, in any language.

registry.description: The [registries] entry the workspace installs from. Default: the public registries.

devcontainer.description: Write .devcontainer/devcontainer.json with the toolchains CI installs. Default: false.

native_runners.description: Machines the native job runs on, one per OS. Default: ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest.

native_linux_packages.description: apt packages the native job installs on Linux before building.

branch.description: The only branch a real release runs from. Default: main.

remote.description: The remote release tags are pushed to. Default: origin.

github_releases.description: Create a GitHub Release for every tag (needs GITHUB_TOKEN). Default: false.

registry.description: The [registries] entry packages are published to. Default: [workspace] registry, then the public registries.

dir.description: The task cache directory, workspace-relative or absolute. Default: .smith/cache.

max_size_mb.description: Prune the least recently used entries past this size. Default: 2048.

remote.description: A shared cache behind the local one: https://host/path, s3://bucket/prefix or azblob://account/container/prefix. Objects are signed with SMITH_CACHE_KEY; one that fails verification is a miss.

remote_read_only.description: Read the remote cache without writing to it (SMITH_CACHE_READ_ONLY=1 does the same). Default: false.

enabled.description: Built-in language plugins to load. Default: all of them.

external.description: Plugins outside the smith binary, by name; one replaces a built-in plugin of the same name.

command.description: The executable and its arguments. Empty: find it installed on the plugin search path.

conventions.description: Plugins applied to every project of the languages they support, by name.

languages.description: Narrow the convention to some of the languages it supports.

registry.description: Docker only: where release pushes the apps' images (ghcr.io/acme). Unset: images are built, never pushed. ghcr.io logs in with GITHUB_TOKEN, docker.io with DOCKERHUB_USERNAME and DOCKERHUB_TOKEN, another registry with CONTAINER_USERNAME and CONTAINER_PASSWORD. For several registries use registries.

description_from.description: Docker only: a workspace-relative file (README.md) whose text becomes the repository description on Docker Hub after a release.

push.description: Docker only: false builds images without pushing them on release. Default: true when a registry is set.

verify.description: Docker only: false stops smith ci verify building the affected apps' images on pull requests. Default: true (an app without Docker on its runner is skipped with a warning).

stacks.description: Stacks declared here, by name: the plugins a project is built with.

language.description: The language plugin that discovers the stack's projects.

toolchain.description: Toolchain plugins, in order: a later one may replace a task an earlier one added.

scaffold.description: The plugin that generates new projects; empty: the language plugin.

default_stacks.description: The stack of a project that records none, and of smith add without --stack, by language plugin.

tasks.description: Overrides of a task for every project, by task name.

projects.description: Settings of one project, by project name.

tag_prefix.description: Replaces the release tag prefix (<name>@ by default).

stack.description: Replaces the stack the project's manifest records.

docker.description: The app's settings for the docker convention.

image.description: The image's name under the registry. Default: the project's name, lowercase.

registry.description: Where release pushes this app's image, instead of the convention's registry or registries.

description_from.description: A workspace-relative file whose text becomes this app's Docker Hub repository description.

push.description: false builds the image but never pushes it on release.

verify.description: false stops smith ci verify building this app's image on pull requests.

context.description: The build context, workspace-relative: "." (the workspace, the default) or a directory such as the app's own, for a Dockerfile written for it (Nx's: docker build apps/api).

split_repo.description: A GitHub repository (owner/repo) each release is mirrored to: the project's directory split out, pushed to its main branch and tagged vX.Y.Z, for a registry that reads a package at a repository root (Packagist). Needs SPLIT_REPO_TOKEN.

registry.description: The [registries] entry this package is published to, instead of [release] registry.

release.description: Makes an app releasable: versioned by its tag, its assets built and attached.

version_variable.description: The symbol the version is stamped into. Default for Go: main.version.

package_managers.description: Manifests generated from the assets and attached to the GitHub Release.

linux_packages.description: Linux packages built from the linux archives (binary in /usr/bin) and attached to the GitHub Release.

npm.description: npm packages the app is published as; the first also names the per-platform packages (<first>-<os>-<cpu>). Needs NODE_AUTH_TOKEN.

pypi.description: PyPI project the app is published as, one wheel per platform. Needs PYPI_TOKEN.

nuget.description: .NET tool package the app is published as (dotnet tool install -g <name>), with one <name>.<rid> package per platform. Needs NUGET_API_KEY.

rubygems.description: Gem the app is published as, one platform gem per platform. Needs GEM_HOST_API_KEY.

pub.description: pub.dev package the app is published as (dart pub global activate <name>), holding every platform's binary. Published from GitHub Actions by the generated pub workflow, through pub.dev's automated publishing.

pub_tag.description: The tag pub.dev's automated publishing matches, with {name} (the release tag prefix without its @) and {version}. Default: {name}-v{version}.

description.description: What the app is, for the package manager manifests.

homepage.description: The app's homepage. Default: the GitHub repository.

license.description: An SPDX license identifier, e.g. MIT.

registries.description: Private package registries by name: Azure Artifacts, GitHub Packages or any token-protected registry.

auth.description: azure-artifacts: the pipeline's own token through Azure's authenticate tasks; github-packages: GITHUB_TOKEN; token: the variable token_env names.

token_env.description: The environment variable holding the token, for auth = "token".

pypi.description: The simple index pip installs from (.../simple/).

pypi_upload.description: Where twine uploads. Default: pypi with /simple/ replaced by /upload/.

dockerRegistries.description: Docker only: the registries release pushes the apps' images to, each under the same name and tags. A "host/namespace" string uses the host's credentials (ghcr.io: GITHUB_TOKEN with packages: write; docker.io: DOCKERHUB_USERNAME and DOCKERHUB_TOKEN; another host: CONTAINER_USERNAME and CONTAINER_PASSWORD, for one only). A table names the variables: { url, username_env, password_env }. Instead of registry, never with it.

task.description: Replaces individual fields of a plugin-inferred task; unset fields keep the plugin's value.

command.description: argv, run without a shell; {workspaceRoot}, {projectRoot} and {smith} are expanded.

cwd.description: Workspace-relative working directory (. is the root).

inputs.description: Globs relative to the project; {workspaceRoot}/... for root files; ! excludes.

outputs.description: Directories restored on a cache hit.
